name: Jehiah
title: Levite and Temple Servant
summary: Jehiah (also spelled Jehijah) was a Levite who served under King David. He is mentioned as one of the Levites responsible for the treasures in the house of the Lord and for the holy offerings. He belonged to the clan of the Gershonites and played a role in organizing temple service.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as Temple Treasurer
keyEvents.description: Jehiah was assigned responsibility for the treasures in the house of the Lord during David's organization of the Levites' service.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the Sons of Ladan
keyEvents.description: Jehiah is mentioned among the sons of Ladan from the clan of the Gershonites, who had special duties in the sanctuary.

keyEvents.title: David's Organization of the Levites
keyEvents.description: As part of David's great organization of the Levites' service, Jehiah and his sons were assigned specific responsibilities related to the temple.

keyEvents.title: Responsibility for the holy offerings
keyEvents.description: Jehiah and his family had oversight of the dedicated gifts and treasures given to the Lord's house by kings, commanders, and other leaders.
